4 ارنق : see 2. ＝
-A2- Also He moved about, or agitated, [or waved,] his banner, previously to a charge, or an assault, in war or battle; (IAar, K;) and [in like manner,] ↓ رَنَقَ , inf. n. رَنْقٌ, he moved about, &c., the banner. (TA.) ＝
-A3- And It (a banner) was moved about or agitated [or waved]; (IAar, K;) and [in like manner,] ↓ رَنَقَ it (a banner) was moved about &c. over the heads. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
